input.use: Coordinate values only; no B3, field, orbit or decoder property is used.

snapshot.scope: One finite interpolation row. Sampled lower bound and full-partition upper bound; no infinite-row convergence conclusion.

execution.scope: One exact rational construction; observed time only, no benchmark or prior computation replay.

result.loader: Structural only; coefficients, partition completeness and bound derivation are not replayed.

reader.scope: One fresh saved open and exact query arithmetic. No cardinal construction, sign-piece formation, power-to-Bernstein conversion or subdivision replay. Two new nodal data vectors are the derived sign witness and the values of |x|.
